SASBDB entry SASDF95  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDF95/)

Publication: Structural Insights Into the Transcriptional Regulation of HigBA Toxin–Antitoxin System by Antitoxin HigA in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.3389/fmicb.2019.03158

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDF95/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
